 Ranabaali Final Worldwide Box Office Collections: Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna starrer wraps theatrical run at Rs 75 crore globally 
 Ranabaali, starring Vijay Sethupathi and Rashmika Mandanna in the lead roles, exhausted its entire box office run on a disappointing note. The period action drama, directed by Rahul Sankrityan, closed its box office journey at Rs. 74.75 crore gross globally. Of this, around Rs. 62.75 crore came from the domestic markets, while the overseas territories contributed around USD 1.25 million. 
 Bankrolled by Mythri Movie Makers, the Telugu movie fetched around Rs. 54.50 crore from its home turf. Furthermore, it grossed around Rs. 6.50 crore from Karnataka and Rs. 1.75 crore from the rest of the Indian markets.
 Since the production costs are on the higher side, the movie failed to recover and flopped at the box office. One of the major reasons behind its failure is mixed word-of-mouth. Had Ranabaali received a positive reception, things would have been much better for its box office trajectory. It will be interesting to see when Vijay Deverakonda finally makes his perfect comeback at the box office.
